notes: Historical 2026 GSoC leads only. None is confirmed for GSoC 2027. Verify org/project policies before contributing.

organizations.name: NumFOCUS / GRASS GIS
organizations.why: Raster processing, satellite imagery, scientific Python; begin with isolated tests or Python code.

organizations.name: Processing Foundation / p5.js
organizations.why: Accessible JS tests and frontend; strong entry point on 8 GB Windows laptop.

organizations.name: NumFOCUS / DeepForest
organizations.why: Direct match for visual recognition and geospatial imagery; select tests, utilities and CPU-safe changes.

organizations.name: OpenVINO Toolkit
organizations.why: CV/ML plus efficiency. Avoid full native builds unless remote compute is available.

organizations.name: Python Software Foundation / MNE-Python
organizations.why: Scientific Python and signal processing; practical unit tests and API improvements.

organizations.name: GNU Radio
organizations.why: ETCE alignment. Scope Python tests before complex C++ DSP or Qt work.

organizations.name: SymPy
organizations.why: Mostly CPU-friendly; strong practice for algorithms and rigorous tests.

organizations.name: Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI)
organizations.why: Research fit, but each project has different prerequisites and repos. Manually identify target idea and evaluation task.

organizations.name: 52°North
